body: Salesforce's new Slackbot AI agent aims to simplify workflows. This shift is crucial for teams looking to improve communication and efficiency. But how does it relate to customer engagement? At Purands AI, we see this as an opportunity. Integrating AI agents with CRM platforms, like Salesforce, can enhance lifecycle messaging. Our AI agents work on top of your CRM and messaging channels, improving win-back campaigns, replenishment reminders, and abandoned-cart recovery. By automating these workflows, brands can focus on what matters - building lasting customer relationships. For example, our AI agents can predict churn and engage customers with personalized messages at the right time, directly through platforms like WhatsApp and Shopify. The result? Measurable improvements in customer retention and repeat purchases. The essence is simple: leverage AI to make customer engagement more efficient and effective. It's not just about internal communication - it's about transforming how you interact with your customers.

topic: Meta Muse Glimmer Brings Local AI Agents to Consumer GPUs
body: Meta's Muse Glimmer is making waves by allowing AI to run on local consumer GPUs, a game-changer for smaller APAC businesses. Running AI locally enhances data privacy and slashes costs, crucial for businesses that can't afford hefty cloud service fees. This open-source model democratizes sophisticated AI tools, making them accessible to businesses of all sizes. At Purands AI, we see this as a pivotal shift. Our retention marketing platform can now leverage these local AI agents to deepen customer engagement without breaking the bank. Imagine having the capability to offer personalized win-back or replenishment strategies while keeping customer data securely in-house. Our AI agents, integrated with CRM and messaging platforms like WhatsApp and Shopify, can predict churn and enhance loyalty programs effectively. By adopting Muse Glimmer, smaller businesses can personalize customer interactions at scale, turning one-time buyers into repeat customers. The key is in the measurable outcomes - reduced churn and increased lifetime value (LTV). It's not just about technology; it's about making it work for your business.
